data.title: Arknights: Endfield PlayStation®5 Technical Test Now Live!
data.brief: PlayStation®5 Technical Test has officially begun! Everything on Talos-II awaits your exploration, E
data.data:
PlayStation®5 Technical Test has officially begun! Everything on Talos-II awaits your exploration, Endministrator.


▼// Test Period

2025-12-11 22:00 (UTC-5) – 2025-12-25 17:00 (UTC-5)


▼// Test Overview

Test Type: Limited-access, free of charge, data-wipe test

Platforms: PlayStation®5 / PlayStation®5 Pro


▼// Important Notes

1. All content available for experience in the [PlayStation®5 Technical Test] is from a work-in-progress build. The content, such as the story, settings, stats, and visual presentation may differ significantly from the launch version and does not represent the final look and quality of the game.

2. The test server will be closed and all data will be deleted after the test ends.

3. Endministrator, please make sure to keep your personal account secure. Do not trust any information regarding account trading, account sharing, or the sale of test installation packages to avoid unnecessary losses.

4. The PlayStation®5 device you use to enter the game for the first time will be registered as your test device. You cannot change your test device throughout the test period. If you try switching to another device after receiving test access, your test account will be suspended. Reinstalling the game, performing system upgrades, reinstalling the operating system, or performing factory resets on the test device may also cause issues that prevent you from logging into your test account. Once suspended, your test account cannot be recovered, and appeals will not be accepted during the test period.


▼// Feedback and Suggestions

If you have any issues or suggestions during the PlayStation®5 Technical Test, feel free to share with us via in-game Customer Support ([Settings] > [Contact Customer Support]) or the PlayStation®5 Technical Test surveys.


Once again, thank you for your continued interest and support for Arknights: Endfield, Endministrator!
